name: USCB Financial Holdings, Inc.
summary: USCB Financial Holdings, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for U.S. Century Bank that provides various personal and business banking products and services in the United States. The company offers small business administration and yacht lending services; homeowners association services, including deposit collection, lockbox services, payment services, and lending products; jurist advantage and private client group services; correspondent banking services for banks in certain Latin America and the Caribbean countries.
